property_summary: Only the stored owner can successfully call withdrawAll (calls by non-owners revert).
Only the recorded owner address can cause the contract C to send out its entire balance via withdrawAll (i.e., withdrawAll succeeds only when msg.sender equals c.owner()).
Only the owner can make the contract send its entire balance out via withdrawAll.
Only the owner address may successfully call withdrawAll (calls by non-owners revert).
If the caller is not the contract owner, calling withdrawAll must revert (only the owner can successfully withdraw).
Only the owner can successfully call withdrawAll (non-owners' calls revert).
If the recipient address is not equal to the contract's owner getter, then the call must have reverted.

For all inputs, only the owner address stored in C may successfully withdraw the contract balance via withdrawAll(address) (calls by non-owner either do not change address(c).balance or revert); the mutant removing the require allows someone else to drain the balance, violating this owner-only withdrawal property.
